purpose: schema_family -> split mapping and the closed OOD/external contracts

policy.train: schemas allowed in the training corpus; rows from any other split must be filtered out
policy.internal_valid: the eight reviewed dev-217 databases; checkpoint selection only
policy.ood_reserved: the ten historical OOD databases plus any lineage near-copy of them (listed in ood_lineage_extensions); never trained, scored on OOD-876
policy.external_test: closed, never trained: three held-out Mini-Dev PostgreSQL schemas plus six empty registry placeholders that have no captured schema

lineage_fingerprint.description: sha256 over canonical JSON of tables (name), columns (name, type, not_null), primary keys and foreign keys

renamed_copy_candidates.method: exact lineage fingerprint equality (tables + keys + column types); then table/column-name Jaccard >= 0.8 / 0.6 over >= 2 shared tables; type-free structure equality across schema sources
renamed_copy_candidates.note: the six empty registry entries share no tables at all; they are placeholders, not renamed copies, and are recorded separately. A near-duplicate candidate that touches an OOD-reserved database is assigned the OOD split so the schema family is never split across train and eval.
